string-array.item: The last few days in Dubai have been wonderful!
I made cute ornaments for the holidays. DM me if want one! I only have 20 left, so get them while they are available!
The geology department found magma on their expedition!
Have you ever seen a dancing baby? Now you have in stunning fashion!
We took the kids to Snoqualmie to ski the slopes. What a fun time!
I found an old temple in the mountains! I wonder what the historical significance is?
Minecraft just gets weirder and weirder…
The van remains in good shape after months on the road!
